info.name: Animating Bite
info.description: The construction for my custom Animating Bite.
info.author: Gustavo Schip

description.p: When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with your Bite, you can choose to animate it. At the next midnight, it rises as a zombie under your control and obeys your simple commands. You can control a number of zombies animated this way up to your proficiency bonus. Any zombies raised beyond this limit are hostile toward you and other creatures. At 18th level, you can raise a vampire spawn instead of a zombie. You can control only one vampire spawn animated this way at a time.
